output.summary: The shrink increase is mainly a receiving-control failure. About 73% of it is in DSD categories. It began after the receiving clerk was eliminated in April 2025. No-clerk stores rose to 3.0% shrink, against 1.7% in clerk stores. An internal audit found invoiced goods exceeded counted goods by 4.9%. A matched pilot cut DSD shrink from 4.4% to 1.9% against flat controls. The count-firm change, associate theft and camera upgrades do not explain the rise. The District 4 bag checks and discipline memo recovered almost nothing and suppressed shortage claims. Organized theft is real but small and unmeasured. Locked cases lost more margin than the shrink they saved. Reinstating receiving is the preferred action.
